questions_and_answers.question: Which phrase best describes the role of science in forming the Clean Water Act? A. Reporting cost-effective ways to reduce pollution B. Monitoring how many people suffer from cholera C. Releasing guidelines to enforce chlorine use at treatment plants D. Determining the need to create the Environmental Protection Agency
questions_and_answers.answer: Phrase best describes the role of science in forming the clean water act is to reporting cost-effective ways to reduce pollution The clean water act aims to prevent, reduce, and eliminate** pollution** in the nation's water in order to restore and maintain the chemical, physical, and biological integrity of the nation's waters and its objective is to restore and maintain the chemical, physical, and biological integrity of the nation's waters by preventing point and non point pollution sources, providing assistance to publicly owned treatment works for the improvement of waste water treatment, and maintaining the integrity of wetlands Know more about clean water act https://brainly.com/question/12154471 #SPJ1

questions_and_answers.question: Read this US policy on clean water. questions_and_answers.answer: to enforce standards that focus on chemical discharge into bodies of water
